learning_outcomes.text: Defining project and project management concepts.
Understanding the differences between routine work and projects.
Learning concepts such as teamwork, consultancy, time and risk management.
Conducting literature review, writing bibliography, and raising awareness of ethical rules.
Experiencing project writing, application, and presentation.

syllabus_topics: Determining project topic, title, and keywords
Teamwork techniques for projects and selecting an academic advisor
How to conduct a literature review
Ethical rules to be observed in research techniques
Risk, procurement, and time management in projects
assessment_rules: Midterm and final exam dates are not specified in the 14-week course schedule but are determined by the University Senate decisions as indicated in the academic calendar.
